title: Towards Measurement Theory for Artificial Intelligence (Extended Abstract)
benchmark_measurement: The paper is a theoretical proposal for a measurement theory of AI and does not conduct any benchmarks or measure any aspects related to faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not analyze any aspects of religion or faith; its focus is on establishing a formal measurement theory for artificial intelligence in general.
